anchor.note: diagnostic anchor; LR_RANGE_UNRESOLVED lineage preserved; not a tuned optimum

constant_lr_plateau.note: 0.001 is the checkpoint END-STEP lr (= 0.01 * cosine_end 0.1); the 0.01 peak is NOT used; no scheduler advance

W0.note: must equal T2a batch_manifest member-by-member (verified pre-freeze)

C.note: 128 common-tail batches, same order for every branch

permutations.collision_rule: seed += 10000 and regenerate until unique within window (pre-declared; not triggered)
permutations.pi0: k=0 of each window; pre-scheduled shuffle reference, not chosen by results

targets.rule: sha256(('T2b_Q_v1|'+group_id).encode()).digest()[0] % 2 -> 0=select, 1=check; group = conversation_id (translation thread), disjoint across sides
targets.pool: OLD dev split only (thread-aligned mte_split_v2); confirm pools remain sealed
targets.q_select_grad: at theta*, no clip, no optimizer write-back, eval-mode forward, RNG isolated

replay.state_semantics: full Muon+AdamW state recursion incl. WD; no M/m/v/step reset inside a track; post-clip G not re-clipped; grads assigned without aliasing
replay.lock: selection_lock.json written before any Q_check access

real_branches.plus_repeat: one extra W0/pi0 full 138-step run for determinism (not an independent sample)
real_branches.divergence_handling: NaN/Inf -> recipe_divergence, logged separately from technical failures

screening.delta_num_rule: max(1e-8, 10*e_repeat), e_repeat from the duplicate run NLL difference
screening.primary: G_F[b,138] = mean_k v[b,k,138] - v[b,k_F,138] > 0 on BOTH windows and k_F not worse than pi0 (tol delta_num)
